regime_context: The S&P 500 thematic detector shows a broad but shallow rotation with Memory/HBM as the faded headline narrative (durability 0.49). The absolute-trend gate historically aids drawdown control. No single narrative dominates; strongest eligible trends are in Financials, Managed Care, and Staples, while many AI-adjacent themes are mixed. Track record is a single miss, so all leans remain low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity may challenge Memory HBM for leadership; watch for a confirmed cross in rank scores while Cybersecurity maintains durability >0.8 and breadth=1.0. Kill this watch if Memory HBM's durability recovers above 0.6 and the score gap widens by more than 0.5.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials EW passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible), shows a durable trend (durability 0.81, hurst=trend) and broad participation (breadth 0.882) with no crowding. The trend gate, the only validated edge, supports overweight exposure to control drawdowns.
theses.dissent: Financials could reverse sharply if recession fears spike and yield curve flattens, compressing margins; the durable trend may break abruptly.

falsifier.text: If the theme's eligibility flips to false or durability drops below 0.5, the trend gate no longer supports overweight.

theses.subject: Crypto & Digital Assets
theses.thesis: Crypto & Digital Assets is eligible but shows extremely low durability (0.48), zero breadth (0.0) and a mixed hurst exponent, indicating no reliable trend. Avoiding it aligns with the absolute-trend gate philosophy of staying with robust trends to limit drawdowns.
theses.dissent: A sudden regulatory shift or ETF-driven retail surge could cause a sharp rally in a few large caps, making the theme appear to break out despite low breadth.

falsifier.text: If durability rises above 0.7 AND breadth climbs above 0.5 within the horizon, the trend structure becomes investable, invalidating the avoid lean.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
